docs.title: Bar manual
docs.text:
Negroni: 1 oz gin, 1 oz Campari, 1 oz sweet vermouth. Stir over ice, strain over one large cube, orange peel.
Lemon Basil Soda: 1 oz lemon juice, 0.75 oz basil syrup, top with soda water over ice, basil leaf.
